title: Home Purchase Financing Late Charges — Prompt-Cure Reduction
content:
**Prompt-cure clause — Home Purchase Financing late charges**

**The installment charged.** The installment charged is the oldest unpaid installment when its grace period has already ended, and otherwise the most recent installment received, received after its grace period.

**Days after the grace period.** Days after the grace period are the calendar days from the installment's due date to the date it was received, less the program's grace days — 15 on every Home-Only Loan program (7-Year, 10-Year, 15-Year, 20-Year, 23-Year and 25-Year Fixed alike).

**The fraction.** Where the installment charged was received 1 to 5 days after its grace period ended, the prompt-cure fraction is 0.5; where it was received 6 to 10 days after the grace period ended, the prompt-cure fraction is 0.8; where it was received later, or is still unpaid at assessment, no prompt-cure reduction applies.

**Where it acts.** The late charge assessed is the late charge already raised to the program's floor and capped at its cap, times the prompt-cure fraction, rounded half up to the cent.

| Installment charged | Days after the grace period | Prompt-cure fraction |
|---|---|---|
| received | 1 to 5 | 0.5 |
| received | 6 to 10 | 0.8 |
| received | 11 or more | none applies |
| still unpaid at assessment | — | none applies |

### Day counts (hypothetical installment due 2026-03-01, grace 15 days)

| Received | Calendar days from the due date | Days after the grace period | Fraction | On a bounded charge of 21.02 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-03-17 | 16 | 1 | 0.5 | 10.51 |
| 2026-03-21 | 20 | 5 | 0.5 | 10.51 |
| 2026-03-22 | 21 | 6 | 0.8 | 16.816, rounded to 16.82 |
| 2026-03-26 | 25 | 10 | 0.8 | 16.82 |
| 2026-03-27 | 26 | 11 | none | 21.02 |
